parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of the tunnel.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key for this WireGuard tunnel.

parameters.name: PublicKey
parameters.description: The public key for this WireGuard tunnel, corresponding to the {{param|PrivateKey}}.

parameters.name: ListenPort
parameters.description: The port on which this WireGuard tunnel will listen for incoming connections. If set to 0, a random port will be chosen by the device.

parameters.name: PeerReferences
parameters.description: Each element represents a reference to the peers associated with this {{object}} entry.

object.description: WireGuard Tunnel table, models the WireGuard Tunnel instance and represents the entry point and exit point of the tunnel in relation to the WAN interface. A {{object}} object has one or more {{object|Interface}} objects that further define the sessions or flows within the tunnel.
